name: Prism Princess ~Futari no Himekishi to Kokan no Monshou~
original_name: プリズム・プリンセス ～ふたりの姫騎士と股間の紋章～
source:
One day, a naked girl appeared in hikikomori Naoto’s room. She stripped off his pants and declared: “I’ve found you, son of the demon lord! Now die!” She swung at him with a sword that she pulled out of nowhere, but it was stopped by another naked girl. “I will definitely protect you…” On top of that, his childhood friend is an idol and his younger sister is not just a chuuni, but secretly a powerful magician!? What the hell is going on?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一天，一个裸体女孩出现在家里蹲直人的房间。她脱下他的裤子，宣布：“找到你了，魔王之子！去死吧！”她从不知何处拔出长剑砍向他，却被另一名裸体女孩挡住。“我一定会保护你……”不仅如此，他的青梅竹马是偶像，妹妹不只是中二病患者，还是隐藏实力强大的魔法师！？这到底是怎么回事？

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
